/-- A partition `a = x₀ < x₁ < ⋯ < xₙ = b` of the interval `[a,b]`. -/
structure DarbouxPartition (a b : ℝ) where
  n : ℕ
  x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ
  mono : StrictMono x
  first : x 0 = a
  last : x (Fin.last n) = b

/-- Upper Darboux sum `U(P,f)`. -/
noncomputable def upperDarbouxSum {a b : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (P : DarbouxPartition a b) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin P.n, sSup (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i.castSucc) (P.x i.succ)) *
    (P.x i.succ - P.x i.castSucc)

/-- Lower Darboux sum `L(P,f)`. -/
noncomputable def lowerDarbouxSum {a b : ℝ} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (P : DarbouxPartition a b) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin P.n, sInf (f '' Set.Icc (P.x i.castSucc) (P.x i.succ)) *
    (P.x i.succ - P.x i.castSucc)

/-- Upper Darboux integral. -/
noncomputable def upperDarbouxIntegral (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ⨅ P : DarbouxPartition a b, upperDarbouxSum f P

/-- The deck transformation group of a map `p : E → X`: homeomorphisms `f` of `E`
with `p ∘ f = p`. -/
def deckGroup {E X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace X] (p : E → X) :
    Subgroup (E ≃ₜ E) where
  carrier := {f | p ∘ f = p}
  mul_mem' := by
    intro f g hf hg
    funext x
    show p (f (g x)) = p x
    have h1 := congrFun hf (g x)
    have h2 := congrFun hg x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
  one_mem' := by
    funext x
    rfl
  inv_mem' := by
    intro f hf
    funext x
    show p (f.symm x) = p x
    have h := congrFun hf (f.symm x)
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact h.symm
